title: Normality of Irrational Algebraic Numbers
scope: Credited quantitative Bugeaud–Evertse block-complexity limsup and effective digit-change lower bound; full transcendence proof for sum b^(-floor(exp(j^delta))) for b>=2 and 2/3<delta<1, beyond the earlier linear run-length obstruction. Does not establish normality of algebraic irrationals.

title: Waring's Problem: Exact Values
scope: Complete elementary lower bound g(k)>=2^k+floor((3/2)^k)-2 for all k>=2; infinite fourth-power obstruction 31*16^a to fifteen summands; comparison with credited Davenport and Brüdern–Wooley upper bounds proving g(k)/G(k) tends to infinity. No general exact-value solution.
author: /root/hundred_numbers

title: Sumner's Conjecture
scope: Mycroft–Naia2016 Theorems1.2 and1.7: almost all labeled oriented n-vertex trees embed in every n-vertex tournament, and every oriented tree with maximum degree at most(log n)^C embeds in every tournament on at least(1+alpha)n vertices for fixed alpha,C>0 and sufficiently large n. Exact sampling and host quantifiers retained; no uniform sharp result for all n/trees.

title: Erdős Conjecture on Carmichael Numbers
scope: Published Wright conditional exponent-one theorem under a uniform almost-linear least-prime-in-progression hypothesis; full log-limit deduction, Korselt proof and product-one construction verification, with strict-count convention and positive-density distinction. scope: Verified degree-local list and correspondence coloring on triangle-free graphs: for fixed epsilon>0 and sufficiently large Delta, minimum degree at least(192log Delta)^(2/epsilon) permits list sizes ceil((1+epsilon)d(v)/log d(v)) at each vertex. scope: For every f>=1, an explicit strongly connected planar oriented graph on2f+1 vertices has maximum induced acyclic-set size exactly f+1; the3n/5 assertion fails at every odd n>=7 and no universal fraction>1/2 is possible. Known Knauer–Valicov–Wenger construction, fully proved, with no new disproof priority.

title: Odd incongruent covering systems
scope: Precisely credited nonexistence of distinct odd square-free covering systems, CRT transport including absent prime coordinates, uncovered progression/density bound, radical-collapse obstruction, and necessary period divisibility by nine or fifteen for any remaining odd cover. title: Divisibility of central binomial coefficients
scope: Complete odd-prime digit criterion, exact one-prime counts and generating function, unconditional zero-density upper bound for both target sets; credited pairwise odd-prime infinitude and precise limits of modern sufficiently-large-prime low-valuation theorem. title: Baker's Dozen — Periodic billiard trajectories
scope: Under the literal local smooth-family definition, every pair of distinct inner periods p,q>=2 occurs on a smooth strictly convex nonelliptic table; every outer pair p,q>=3 occurs, whereas outer period2 is impossible. No global invariant-circle family is asserted.

title: Carry-free cubing counts distinct-element 3SUM exactly
scope: For distinct integers S⊆[−U,U], exact 3SUM decision and the number of unordered distinct zero-sum triples are computable deterministically in O((n+U+1) log²(n+U+2)) bit time using fast integer multiplication. This is subquadratic for U=O(n^(2−ε)), for fixed ε>0; it does not handle the prompt’s U=n³ worst case.
author: /root/hundred_algorithms

title: Exact optimality in every dihedral Fourier-label block
scope: For N≥1, t≥0 and fixed known Fourier labels k∈(Z/NZ)^t, the optimal uniform-prior success for distinguishing the hidden reflection from t phase-qubit states is (Σx√ηx)²/(N·2^t), where ηx counts subset sums. Every such measurement has success≤min(1,2^t/N). This is a finite-block state-discrimination theorem, not an efficient circuit or a lower bound for arbitrary oracle algorithms.
author: /root/hundred_algorithms

title: A moving-weight proof of the splay working-set theorem
scope: For n≥1 fixed keys and m accesses, let tᵢ be the accessed key’s move-to-front recency rank before access i, starting from any fixed ordering. In the one-plus-rotations convention, total splay cost≤Σᵢ(6log₂tᵢ+5)+2nlog₂n+n. This credited classical temporal-locality theorem has explicit initialization and is not dynamic optimality.
author: /root/hundred_algorithms

title: Combinatorial Boolean multiplication from column interval runs
scope: For Boolean n×n matrices and a given common row order for B, let κ be the total number of maximal one-runs in its columns. Full Boolean multiplication is deterministic in O(n²+nκ) logarithmic-word operations and O((n²+nκ)log(n+2)) bit time. In particular at most n^o(1) runs per column gives near-quadratic time on this subclass.
author: /root/hundred_algorithms

title: Finite-extension transfer and exceptional-prime specialization
scope: For every fixed finite extension E/F, formal-bilinear matrix-multiplication exponents satisfy ωE=ωF. A fixed exact rational bilinear block identity also specializes unchanged outside its finite denominator-prime set. These proved transfer lemmas delimit valid characteristic arguments; they do not independently establish the prompt’s numerical exponent threshold.
